scope: Detached fixed-layout length/assembly identity consistency only. No geometry/DRC recomputation, authenticated file content, source-board equivalence or manufacturer acceptance.

release_exclusions: Scoped geometry export, not fabrication readiness or clearance/continuity certification
No legacy previews, inner copper, pours, arcs, component through holes/slots, blind/buried/microvias, paste, silkscreen, netlist/X3 assembly or material/finish/stackup instructions
Mask expansion is an export parameter; all vias untented; no manufacturer rules inferred

Generic bom.csv and placement.csv inventory all components at component origins. populated-bom.csv and calibrated-placement.csv contain the same explicitly populated all-mounting component subset; their stable identity digest is declared separately.

Sourcing identifiers are exact user-entered values and may be unavailable; no stock, procurement, inferred identifiers or vendor certification. The generic top-view marker does not establish universal vendor zero, polarity, tape orientation or manufacturer-specific mounting filters.
checks_performed: Strict supported release/job layout and version/profile/summary matrix
Declared/observed regular file byte lengths and observed path/descriptor identity stability
When present: calibrated row/count validity and populated shared fields/component membership/identity digest
checks_not_performed: No authenticated file-content digest, original-export authenticity or current-board equality
No geometry/Gerber/XNC/legacy assembly/validation report semantic or DRC recomputation
Unlisted filesystem entries not inspected; per-file inspector caps may refuse otherwise valid larger exports
Independent file reads are not an atomic cross-file snapshot; same-length unchecked-content edits can pass and files may change after return
